name: 20 Microns Ltd
title: 20 Microns Ltd - 533022 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 revenue up 14.8% YoY on paint and polymer recovery, EBITDA margin ~12%, but management declined to give FY27 revenue or margin guidance and utilisation was not disclosed; capex of Rs100 cr (about 16% of market cap) is growth-oriented, not capacity-led.

capex.quote: About the 100 crore CapEx plan announced by the company should be viewed as a strategic growth accelerator rather than capacity expansion.

triggers.label: FY27 guidance withdrawn/not given
triggers.quote: we don't find it suitable enough to give any kind of broader picture in terms of the expected revenues

triggers.label: Q4 uptick tied to war-driven pre-buying
triggers.quote: many people try to you know build up on the capacity so that based upon the raw materials that they were already holding

triggers.label: Cost pass-through lagged, case by case
triggers.quote: in many cases we do pass it on to our customers, but it doesn't happen immediately

triggers.label: Current demand weaker per management
triggers.quote: currently the demand is a little weaker

triggers.label: Plan deferral conditional on geopolitics
triggers.quote: the Company shall modify or defer its phase plans accordingly

guidance.quote: considering the next three-year plan with the CapEx, around 18% of revenue CAGR growth
we are expecting Roce around 20% in case by FY30 if the things in the projects are timely being delivered
we'll see the growth that we anticipate to you know, cross the thousand crore benchmark and milestone hopefully in this financial year

red_flags.label: FY27 revenue and margin guidance withheld
red_flags.quote: we don't find it suitable enough to give any kind of broader picture in terms of the expected revenues

red_flags.label: Pre-buying from war-driven hoarding
red_flags.quote: many people try to you know build up on the capacity so that based upon the raw materials that they were already holding

red_flags.label: Fuel/gas shortage risk
red_flags.quote: We definitely are facing a lot of issues in terms of the gas or the fuels that we use currently

evasions.quote: we don't find it suitable enough to give any kind of broader picture in terms of the expected revenues that we would foresee
once it's ready and you know the commissioning and everything is done and when it's put to use, only then we will be able to comment on this
it's very difficult to predict as of now because of the current situations
